data_requirements.format: A finite pool of examples batchable by a PyTorch classifier; classification labels are needed only when training the supplied model.
data_requirements.auto_download_details: MNIST, CIFAR-10, and SVHN can be obtained through torchvision; AG News can be obtained through a standard dataset loader.
data_requirements.synthetic_description: Synthetic vectors with a small linear classifier can demonstrate gradient-embedding construction and batch selection.
